description: Create an event on a LinkedIn company Page the brand administers: an EXTERNAL online event (a webinar on Zoom, YouTube or your own site — pass url), an IN-PERSON event (pass address), or a LinkedIn Live event (format:"live" — that one needs LinkedIn Live access on the member, and without it LinkedIn refuses with “The member does not have LINKEDIN_LIVE creation access”, measured 2026-08-31). Optionally attach a LinkedIn REGISTRATION FORM (registrationForm:true + privacyPolicyUrl, or your own approved leadFormId); sign-ups arrive as EVENT leads in list_linkedin_leads(leadType:"EVENT"). Read back from LinkedIn. Warning: ANNOUNCING IS A SEPARATE, PUBLIC STEP (announce:true does it in this call): LinkedIn requires a SEPARATE post to make an event publicly visible, so creating one puts nothing in anyone’s feed and the brand decides when to tell people. That separation is LinkedIn’s own and it is why an agent cannot accidentally broadcast to a company’s followers. Edit it with update_linkedin_event until it starts. A custom background image is not offered yet. Needs the Events permission (administrator flag) and a reconnect, the same two conditions as list_linkedin_events. 0 credits.

line1.description: venue street address, first line (in_person events)

announce.description: ALSO publish the Page post that shares the event. LinkedIn makes an event reachable only once a post shares it (an unannounced one stopped being readable within a minute, measured 2026-10-27). PUBLIC — show the user the copy and get a yes first

announceText.description: the copy of the announcing post

description.description: event description shown on the event page

discoveryMode.description: LISTED (shown in event search) or URL_ONLY (reachable by link only)

endsAt.description: ISO 8601, after startsAt; defaults to one hour after the start

format.description: inferred from url / address when omitted; live needs LinkedIn Live access

leadFormId.description: or attach your own APPROVED lead form instead of registrationForm

organizationId.description: the Page — omit if only one is shared with this profile

privacyPolicyUrl.description: privacy policy link; required with registrationForm:true

registrationForm.description: attach a LinkedIn-built registration form (needs privacyPolicyUrl)

startsAt.description: ISO 8601, must be in the future — LinkedIn rejects an event that has already begun

url.description: external: where it streams or where people join; in_person: an info page

name: create_linkedin_event
title: Create a LinkedIn event
